d:
Bam Adebayo delivered a historic performance against the Oklahoma City Thunder, recording 24 points, 15 rebounds, and a career-high 12 assists for his 9th career triple-double, tying LeBron James for the second-most triple-doubles in Miami Heat franchise history behind only Jimmy Butler (13). Bam recorded his first triple-double since November 29, 2024, as Miami secured a 123-113 victory to extend its winning streak to seven games and improve to 10-6 on the season!
